name: devhost.sys
description: devhost.sys is a WHQL attestation-signed kernel driver that exposes arbitrary memory read primitives to usermode. The device object at \\.\devhost has no ACL beyond a device handle. At load, the driver reads IA32_LSTAR MSR to locate ntoskrnl base via backward MZ walk, then dynamically resolves APIs
